title: Derived open units descend along a pro-etale cover
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes, $U\subseteq X$ an open subscheme, and $a:Y\to X$ any morphism. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], with its pulled-back rings $\Lambda_Z$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Let $N$ be any internal $\Lambda_Y$-module [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], and let $\{b_i:Y_i\to Y\}$ be a pro-etale covering [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Put $j:U\times_XY\to Y$ and $j_i:U\times_XY_i\to Y_i$, formed directly using $b_i\circ a$. If the specified ordinary unbounded derived open unit [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull] at $(b_i^*N)[0]$ for $j_i$ is invertible for every $i$, then the specified derived unit at $N[0]$ for $j$ is invertible. No scalar-test hypothesis, affineness or local freeness is imposed. The canonical pullback associator identifies the chart open with the successive base change of $j$. Empty covers are included.

proof.text: Covering maps are weakly etale. Express internal modules as section-ring module sheaves and identify their pullbacks along these maps with exact slice restriction, preserving the ordinary adjunction units.

proof.text: Restrict a K-injective resolution of j^*N[0] to the open over each chart. It remains K-injective by exact extension by zero. For every object V of that chart, both restricted direct-image computations evaluate the resolution on V times_X U. The canonical pullback associator preserves the projections, so the ordinary restriction maps agree as well as their endpoints.

proof.text: The exact/K-flat derived-adjunction comparison preserves the units: the ordinary unit followed by the direct image of the chosen resolution has transpose the identity. Therefore the restricted specified unit is conjugate by canonical isomorphisms to the specified unit of the directly formed pullback along cover.f i composed with a.

proof.text: The hypothesis makes all chart units invertible. The preceding comparison makes the restrictions of the original unit invertible. Apply joint conservativity of exact derived covering restrictions, which detects all cohomology sheaves, and transport back. Empty covers are included.

lean.statement:
theorem isIso_open_unit_of_cover
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (a : Y ⟶ X)
    (N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ Y))
    (𝒰 : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage Y)
    (hlocal : ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
      IsIso ((CondensedRing.derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction Λ
        (pullback.snd U.ι (𝒰.f i ≫ a))).unit.app
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            ((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ (𝒰.f i)).obj N)))) :
    IsIso ((CondensedRing.derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction Λ
      (pullback.snd U.ι a)).unit.app ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj N))
